title: Evidence routing
objective: Answer a readiness/blocker question by following the Aurora evidence chain rather than similar distractor text.
candidatePrompt: Project SYN-AURORA-001: can gate G-A3 transition to Verified right now? Name the blocking finding and whether stale receipt R-STALE-01 is current. Ignore lookalike and Orion records. Cite evidence IDs.
forbiddenAssumptions: Do not treat semantically similar lookalike records as Aurora.
Do not attribute Orion records to Aurora.
Do not treat R-STALE-01 as current.
Do not query a live database.
hardFailConditions: Answering that G-A3 is Verified or may verify now.
Citing SYN-DISTRACTOR-SIMILAR or SYN-ORION-CROSS-PROJECT as Aurora evidence.
Treating R-STALE-01 as the current receipt.

humanReviewRubric.question: Did the candidate follow project → gate → finding → current receipt rather than keyword similarity?
